name: Mirror of Self-Awareness
description: Lets you name what you are feeling as you feel it.

name: Anchor of Self-Regulation
description: Steadies you long enough to choose a response instead of reacting.

name: Lens of Empathy
description: Shows a situation as someone else is experiencing it.

name: Compass of Motivation
description: Points toward what matters to you, even when nothing feels urgent.

name: Bridge of Social Skill
description: Helps two sides cross toward each other.

name: Lantern of Optimism
description: Shows that a setback is temporary and specific, not permanent and total.

name: Cloak of Adaptability
description: Lets you adjust to a changing situation without losing yourself.

name: Boots of Perseverance
description: Carries you through one more attempt after many failed ones.

name: Rope of Connection
description: Ties you to people who can help when you cannot go on alone.

name: Ember of Purpose
description: Reminds you why you started when you are running out of energy.
